### Why It Happens

- **Fluid shifts:** Alcohol suppresses antidiuretic hormone (vasopressin), causing fluid loss at first, followed by water retention in loose facial tissues (especially around the eyes, cheeks, and jaw). Salty foods eaten while drinking can make this worse.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXcQtD4lif11nNk7KMW-rXVmcb9tRu6d2Xgai7zdLk8EOymtDqv4FKnKq6Fs9P2-9KIKtynwoFxA1CQ9e8pLU7X4KeXfEXM2tbWWHjQpAjqV7CCLf6zXqeycOJkScwJjbHinlKknMlk43beQs3OU-IntSQmTDq)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESawHEIkXXvAL9YJve-LBdtr1yA2EHtH1iAh9r3Vr-hbaHCTkkpde59s8YTnakajQULI378kXSPGnO-KdL56CU4zkFH9XEzy0uFt8p3J8dFnsy2xOhBnx9lsrbx_4uSbBEv5n7TM1fmtX-2xP8)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESeQHEIkXXTIx5c6ZTl_MxNkK6GSQ-zAvrzYPg3jQXNPgC9h2ROcsDh061MlRC9Vh1lps_5qNm4d9zdLHo474Xe87Ga90SiAOsru7u5DW-6_deoqVULUKvAoT00_A242uSwNdhXYA0_JZqU0MLBcSewOfqf4juGMdo5jE)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmQEBxCJF1-CGADBW589bxWIsNTPTjthjF-HnRNYKHGPmFzcY39qu9C7FFuGf3NtfVXjk5J7y1l4Iq9njEjf-9Cua6686V1jCPr8kHdDjhgv7LubD2WkWtxPeh6aIWtUiaq1PK_qR_RALj5FfA3Jh1-tH16Hi8WuBhgDY9aZoNfR7opfz4CQJeC-G_g166uT_j_-qTjBlYYRzOmQ)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXBSOyg7Mjts_uW6uFLFXtmO9BomNHqec46mvookN6Mo0aEGczKCKNp4Prb37vpNJOSyJLOsVYjJwj28mkZghlvDbRuBCR_yS-U8PI1shjNDwkUkXo21jdxuaAzHR73EhJ)

### How to Reduce Morning-After Puffiness

- **Rehydrate:** Drink water and eat hydrating, potassium-rich foods (like cucumbers, melons, or bananas) while limiting extra salt.
- **Cool the skin:** Apply a cold compress or chilled eye mask to narrow dilated vessels and ease swelling.
- **Adjust posture and massage:** Prop your head up slightly when resting and use gentle lymphatic massage toward the neck. [Westlake Dermatology](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXU7fR4d3HirmMCDkpev-IS4ZYFQ2ZbNNcM-YNh6UMhmYslrknh2ESJXkF8uETWsIyzAzBikf_OQJABMTd-ozd-IKis6xaHRGIihfqwwgPtPwPHVy7MZhvXcMAIsl6kHoW3vq7BRMfZpYE7SFQwkVKPwiJh7-k) provides step-by-step tips on preventing and easing morning-after facial swelling and redness.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXtHYkvuzt9GxRCKf2jJOi75_G5GTrDiDfr6ZEk3mm26Xpon5IRNg7-b9CEPSi5kKAxlkdD05w_ixK1VDf6cEne808XN7I2VA8ZH-3WiHf0TmwzzHAkzfmPJt99vWu9MgPeVfxUKxdhw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESmQEBxCJF1-CGADBW589bxWIsNTPTjthjF-HnRNYKHGPmFzcY39qu9C7FFuGf3NtfVXjk5J7y1l4Iq9njEjf-9Cua6686V1jCPr8kHdDjhgv7LubD2WkWtxPeh6aIWtUiaq1PK_qR_RALj5FfA3Jh1-tH16Hi8WuBhgDY9aZoNfR7opfz4CQJeC-G_g166uT_j_-qTjBlYYRzOmQ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXUucOoRinoER0esnmeZ7gtHtxx8C1Z1aiBoKJ6B17nQFZcuamrIjNbXhVb5zGtoyKhyHz0j7QCZVJFFkqtGPP30OS2nR9nEHw-9iXyTI854H8INmHLvqwUUo4ag4AIcwI1Oq2PfDBgQ)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXU7fR4d3HirmMCDkpev-IS4ZYFQ2ZbNNcM-YNh6UMhmYslrknh2ESJXkF8uETWsIyzAzBikf_OQJABMTd-ozd-IKis6xaHRGIihfqwwgPtPwPHVy7MZhvXcMAIsl6kHoW3vq7BRMfZpYE7SFQwkVKPwiJh7-k)

Mild puffiness usually clears within a few days of not drinking. If swelling is severe, one-sided, lasts even after stopping alcohol, or comes with yellowing skin or trouble breathing, seek medical care.
